title: How to Monetize Your Vibe-Coded App: From Prototype to Paid
summary: You built the app. Now how do you charge for it? Stripe subscriptions, freemium tiers, one-time payments, and usage-based pricing — the complete monetization guide for vibe coders.
body_markdown: To accept payments through Stripe, you need a Stripe account, which requires a tax ID (SSN for sole proprietors in the US, or company EIN). You can start as a sole proprietor — an LLC is not required to start charging. Check your local regulations for business registration requirements when your revenue becomes significant.
